gloss: to make inquiries; to investigate by questioning

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {聞|き}き{込|こ}みませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {聞|き}き{込|こ}んでいなかった

definitions.gloss: to make inquiries; to investigate by questioning
definitions.explanation: to gather information by asking around, especially used in detective or journalistic contexts

examples.japanese: ⟦{刑事|けいじ}→刑事：02741_keiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聞|き}き{込|こ}み→聞き込み：13919_kikikomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The detective made inquiries in the neighborhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{込|こ}む。
examples.english: I make inquiries to find witnesses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{込|こ}んで、⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}き{止|と}めた→突き止める：09344_tsukitomeru⟧。
examples.english: The reporter investigated by questioning those involved and uncovered the truth.

notes:
{聞|き}き{込|こ}む is a compound verb meaning to investigate by questioning people, commonly used in detective and journalism contexts.

VERB TYPE: Godan verb (u-verb), intransitive

WRITING:
- ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear, ask)
- ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into, thoroughly)

DERIVED NOUN:
- ⟦{聞|き}き{込|こ}み→聞き込み：13919_kikikomi⟧ (inquiry, investigation by questioning)
- ⟦{聞|き}き{込|こ}み→聞き込み：13919_kikikomi⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧ (door-to-door investigation)

USAGE:
- Police investigations (⟦{刑事|けいじ}→刑事：02741_keiji⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧)
- Journalism (⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧)
- Private investigations

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{込|こ}む (to make inquiries to ~)
- ⟦{聞|き}き{込|こ}み→聞き込み：13919_kikikomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to conduct interviews/inquiries)
- ⟦{聞|き}き{込|こ}み→聞き込み：13919_kikikomi⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (inquiry-based investigation)

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{聞|き}き{出|だ}す→聞き出す：06976_kikidasu⟧ (to get information out of someone)
- ⟦{聞|き}き{取|と}る→聞き取る：04583_kikitoru⟧ (to catch/understand what was said)
- {聞|き}き{回|まわ}る (to ask around)
